title: Tactical Nuclear Weapon Use (Red-Line Escalation Variable)
statement: Two-leg probability of tactical nuclear weapon use within the escalation-ladder window. LEG A (Russia in/around Ukraine, ~25% +/-5%): supported by Russia's lowered nuclear doctrine treating a non-nuclear Ukrainian strike supported by a nuclear NATO sponsor as a 'joint armed attack' threatening retaliation against the sponsor; rises as institutional off-ramps close (consulate expulsions, credibility drain, immunity-blanket failure) because the doctrine is DESIGNED to paralyze NATO vertical escalation. LEG B (Baltic/NATO/adversarial theater, ~10-12%): materially lower because crossing a NATO border crosses Article 5, which the gray-zone 'immunity blanket' is engineered to provoke WITHOUT crossing. STRONG CANCELER: no actor in a losing-conventional position has used a tactical nuke in 80 years, because leaders read it as converting a recoverable setback into a permanent catastrophe. NET CASS READ: P(tactical nuke preceding end of ladder) ~= 15-25% — real but not foregone; the hinge where deterrence holds (most likely) or catastrophically fails (small, rising, undismissable).
evidence_confirmed: RUSSIAN NUCLEAR DOCTRINE SHIFT (documented, board): non-nuclear strike on Russia by Ukraine supported by a nuclear power treated as 'joint armed attack' — the explicit threshold-lowering.
OFF-RAMP DRAWDOWN (Sept 2026): German consulate St. Petersburg expulsion + Lavrov 'real war' frame — institutional channels closing, raising the cornered-leader probability.
'IMMUNITY BLANKET' MECHANISM: nuclear doctrine acting as deterrent shield that paralyzes NATO vertical escalation — the wedge that keeps conflict sub-Article-5 (board: kinetic-european-conflict).
'NUCLEAR THRESHOLD SIGNAL' watch item on world-war-iii-prologue track.
evidence_contradicted: 80-YEAR BASE-RATE: no tactical-nuke use by a conventionally-behind power since 1945; leaders correctly read it as catastrophic self-harm.
DOCTRINE AS BLUFF-FOR-DETERRENCE: the doctrine's purpose is paralysis, not use; its credibility depends on non-use.
Ukraine demilitarizing rather than marching on Moscow — no present existential-threshold trigger for escalation to nukes.
falsifier: Leg A breaks if a US/NATO conventional victory or a negotiated off-ramp (e.g., November Pause, China mediation) removes the cornered-leader condition and the nuclear threshold is never reached; Leg B breaks if no Baltic/NATO nuclear threat ever materializes through the full cascade. The track is falsified as 'likely' if both legs stay below 50% through end-of-window while conflict remains regionalized.

First acute trigger most probable T-40 to T-20 (early-to-late October, 28.3%). Terminal stress: Hormuz 0.97 (blockade irreversible), De-Dollarization 0.67.

title: Cognitive labor reprices first; political instability concentrates in the credentialed middle class
statement: Through 2030, AI deployment will visibly reprice cognitive work (entry-level white collar, junior legal/finance/analysis, routine coding) faster than physical and relational work. The political friction from displacement will concentrate in the credentialed middle class — the overproduced cognitive elite — manifesting as credential-devaluation fights, elite-turned-populist movements, and enclosure battles over who may deploy AI professionally.
falsifier:
By end of 2030, either (a) cognitive-sector unemployment/wage compression remains statistically indistinguishable from pre-2025 trends, or (b) the strongest political AI-backlash constituencies turn out to be working-class/physical-labor sectors rather than credentialed professionals.

title: Recursive acceleration: AI-on-AI-research compresses progress only after 2028, if at all
statement: Deploying AI on AI research itself (designing architectures, running experiments, writing proofs) will NOT produce visibly super-linear research acceleration before 2028. Some acceleration is real but bounded by compute, physical experiments, and coordination overhead. If super-linear acceleration appears, it appears 2028-2029 at the earliest, and concentrates in software/algorithm domains before physical-world domains.
evidence_confirmed: Amodei cites 'industry-wide RSI (recursive self-improvement) since summer 2026' as trigger for slowdown call
Sept 14 market repricing shows acceleration expectations were priced in and are now hedged
falsifier:
A verifiable example of a frontier system producing a Nobel-caliber or field-redirecting scientific breakthrough ahead of expert consensus timelines before 2028; or, conversely, research throughput visibly doubling year-over-year in AI-capability metrics by 2027 (would contradict the bounded claim).

title: The decisive political fight is over scaffolds and epistemic infrastructure, not models
statement: Public debate will fixate on model capability and 'AI safety' in the alignment sense, while the decisive enclosure fight — who owns memory, audit structures, personal archives, and trusted epistemic infrastructure — happens mostly in platform terms-of-service, procurement contracts, and standards bodies, largely unnoticed. Populations with disciplined epistemic scaffolds will measurably outperform those without (literacy-as-scaffold becomes a policy issue by 2030).
evidence_confirmed: Sept 12: all four lab principals publicly endorse coordinated slowdown; Amodei 'We Must Pace the Frontier'
Sept 14: markets reprice instantly — Nasdaq -1.2% open, SoftBank -10.7%, SK Hynix -6.4%, ASML -6%, Micron/SanDisk -6% — the fight over pacing IS a fight over capital
Sept 14: Trump names Anthropic/Dario directly, claims personal guardrail role, threatens 'Treasonists, Traitors, and Leakers BEWARE'
Sept 14: Politico — chance of Congress acting on AI 'in the coming weeks is next to zero'
falsifier:
Either (a) major legislation or regulation explicitly addressing user-owned memory/audit/scaffold portability emerges and dominates AI political debate by 2030 (claim too pessimistic about inattention), or (b) by 2030 no measurable gap exists between scaffolded and unscaffolded populations in belief-accuracy or manipulation resistance (claim too optimistic about scaffold effects).

title: AGI arrives as an uneven profile, not a clean threshold
statement: There will be no identifiable moment or system that counts as 'AGI arrives.' Systems will show superhuman performance in some capacities (synthesis, coding, exam tasks) while remaining unreliable at long-horizon agency, physical-world grounding, and self-knowledge of when they are wrong. Public debate will keep treating it as binary; the reality will remain a gradient through at least 2030.
falsifier:
A broadly accepted benchmark or event by which the field itself dates 'AGI achieved' as a clean threshold — e.g., a system passing a pre-registered cross-domain test suite with consensus from major labs that the AGI line has been crossed.
